headlines: TSM is the one to watch. It's inside a flip zone that has been moving ($327–368), under its largest $390 level (+1.0K). Support at $345 is weak; below that there's none around $320. It's net negative into opex (−42.4K), so swings are likely to be bigger.
AAPL has the most positioning into opex (+174K), centred on $360–370. The 11/25 expiry is net negative, though, so the next few sessions could be choppy.

GOOGL is on its $277–292 flip zone but net negative into opex (−22.1K), so swings are likely to be bigger. TSLA faces resistance at $390–400 (and it's sitting on its $372–394 flip zone), and AMZN at $255–260 (and it's sitting on its $247–257 flip zone).
AVGO closed below its flip ($308–317), with net negative positioning into opex, so moves can run until it gets back above.
Looking to the 1/15 opex, AAPL has the most positioning (+369K); NVDA, AVGO, and TSM stay net negative into both opex dates; GOOGL flips from negative this month to positive.
NVDA is the weakest board, at −55.8K into opex. It's inside its $137–166 flip zone, and TradeEcho rates it 3/5.
